description: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include.

detailed.description: [read-only] If true, returns structured JSON with metadata and raw XML.

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP program or include

object_type.description: [read-only] ADT object type of the parent. Only these four values are supported: 'PROG/P' (program), 'PROG/I' (include), 'FUGR' (function group), 'CLAS/OC' (class). Any other value is rejected by the schema.

timeout.description: [read-only] Timeout in ms for each ADT request.

name: GetIncludesList
